title: The Exception
summary: Start: enter The Exception. The log opens the job and the helm marks the License Warden. Do: come within 320 meters of the License Warden. The warden slides alongside and reads the one sanctioned shard. The plague hook is the other body and is not a gift. Finish: after the warden is met, come inside Research Shard's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
